episodes.title: Could You Offer More?
episodes.summary: As drug deaths surge in '90s Britain, the government turns to a veteran customs investigator to recruit a novice unit for an unprecedented covert mission.

episodes.title: Alliance
episodes.summary: Customs recruit Guy faces tests that threaten to blow his cover. Meanwhile, the team in Liverpool chase the scent of a suspicious bakery.

episodes.title: This is Liverpool
episodes.summary: A volatile alliance puts Guy at the heart of a high-risk smuggling deal. The Legends in Liverpool embark on a surveillance mission that ends in trouble.

episodes.title: The War on Drugs
episodes.summary: Cracks start to appear in both gangs as tensions, pressure and paranoia run high. Kate looks to exploit a possible weakness in Carter's armour.

episodes.title: Old Kings
episodes.summary: While Kate chases a murky trail of corruption, a potential meeting with a feared drug lord sends Guy, Bailey and Don on a dangerous overseas mission.

episodes.title: Legends Never Die
episodes.summary: Betrayal, distrust and ambition put the entire mission — and the Legends — at risk. Can they stop an unprecedented heroin shipment from reaching Britain?
